changelog: Sync from structs-ai v1.25.0: updated content, commands, and mechanics for v0.21.0. Renamed from structs-diplomacy
summary: Permissions, address management, and delegation in Structs. Use when granting/revoking permissions on objects or addresses, registering additional signing keys, managing multi-address accounts, or setting up minimum-permission delegate agents (mining bot, defense watcher, co-pilot). Covers the full 25-bit permission model and delegation recipes for multi-agent play.
